text:
ben_marketing: Quick sync  target announce Tue 11:30 PT. Marketing needs: canonical changelog URL, docs prod URL, final hero image (1200x628), bench snapshot (2 metrics), webinar reg link, and inbound lead webhook mapping. Who can confirm each?

devin_eng: Changelog merged to main earlier today -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/501. CDN invalidate queued; canonical will be https://changelog.redwood.ai/2026-03-25-runtime-opts once done. Bench snapshot for blog: median 7.9ms/token (p95 19.8ms) on seq=256; previous baseline 11.0ms/token. Cost ~ -21% per 1k tokens on our mixed traffic profile. Method: 30k anonymized requests replayed across us/eu, FP16 runs + dynamic batching.

lina_product: Product requests a 20m canary window starting 11:05 PT, then ramp 50% for 15m, then 100% at 11:40 PT if no alerts. Also need a 20-word hero caption for the blog.

sam_ops: Ops ok on timing. release-bot scheduled deploy: `deploy job #792 scheduled 2026-03-25T11:05:00-07:00`. Health checks: /health, token-latency, error-rate. Canary window 00:20. I'll pin the rollback window 0-30m after full rollout.

release-bot: Deploy job #792: target clusters [hosted-api, dedicated-pool-b]. Canary 20m -> ramp 50% 15m -> full. Alerts: token-latency > 2x baseline, 5xx > 0.5% over 5m.

iris_docs: Docs publish is ready; staging link: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-25. Will publish to prod when changelog canonical is live. Added "What's new" + migration note. Quickstart snippet (python) added to the top: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$RW_TOKEN")
print(client.generate("Hello from Redwood"))
```

joel_sales: For the email, can we A/B test subject lines? Option A: "Redwood Runtime: Faster, cheaper inference out now" Option B: "Reduce latency and cost with the new Redwood runtime"

ben_marketing: I like A for newsletter and B for direct outbound. Maria is OOO so Joel will own subject line test. Need hero image S3 path + alt text and webinar CTA (1-line).

devin_eng: Hero image can be the marketing master in s3://marketing-assets/launch/2026-03-25/hero_final_v2.png. Alt text suggestion: "Redwood inference runtime dashboard and GPU cluster illustration". Webinar CTA: "Watch the launch demo + live Q&A  Mar 27" -> https://events.redwood.ai/launch-2026

iris_docs: Migration note snippet added under "Upgrading": "If you pinned a model variant, no changes needed. For custom kernel users, see the runtime-compat section." Also added a small code diff example for pinned models.

sam_ops: Inbound lead webhook confirmed and mapped to CRM: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-2026 -> maps to crm.field.source=announce-launch, crm.campaign=launch-2026. Also set Slack alert to #sales-inbound.

ben_marketing: Two marketing asks left: 1) confirm changelog canonical URL once CDN done, 2) confirm docs prod URL after publish. I'll pin the email at 10:00 PT on publish day. Please drop final confirmations here. :memo:

devin_eng: CDN invalidate completed at 18:12 PT, canonical changelog URL is live: https://changelog.redwood.ai/2026-03-25-runtime-opts.

iris_docs: Published docs to prod at 18:20 PT -> https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-25. "What's new" and quickstart visible.

joel_sales: Subject line test set: Option A -> 60% bucket, Option B -> 40%. Creative live in Mailer.

sam_ops: Release bot will post back here after canary completes. Dashboard for monitor: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/launch/2026-03-25.

ben_marketing: Perfect, locking schedule. Final checklist ticked: changelog url, docs prod, hero image, bench blurb, webinar link, inbound webhook, subject A/B. I'll publish at 11:30 PT. If anyone sees anything odd after publish ping #marketing immediately. :rocket:

release-bot: Deploy #792: canary completed at 11:25 PT, no alerts. Ramp to 50% started 11:26 PT. Full rollout 11:41 PT.

ben_marketing: Announce published. Pulling social posts now and triggering Mailer. Will post archive links once live.

devin_eng: Note for ops/marketing: we enabled fallback routing to rwd-1-small if p95 latency spikes > 2.5x baseline. Mention in internal playbook only.

ben_marketing: Thanks team  closing thread. Archived assets in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/2026-03-25. :white_check_mark:
